neighbours.label: Fires on a modifier that predicts an effort word next ('concerted', 'hard' before work, 'diligent', 'how hard ... have' before 'to work'); quiet on the same sentences with modifiers that do not set up effort, including physical 'hard'.
fire: The two parties made a concerted attempt to pass the bill.
Our volunteers deserve credit for months of hard work on the shelter.
The museum launched a concerted campaign to recover stolen art.
Her degree was the reward for years of hard work and sacrifice.
Given how hard the teachers have to work, the strike made sense.
After a diligent search, the clerk finally found the missing deed.
Despite a strenuous effort, the climbers turned back below the summit.
The firm thanked its staff for all their hard work this year.
quiet: The two parties made a quick decision to pass the bill.
Our volunteers laid a hard wooden floor in the shelter.
The museum launched a new website to display its art.
Her degree was framed and hung on the wall of her office.
Given how cold the teachers' rooms are, the strike made sense.
After a short delay, the clerk finally found the missing deed.
Despite the thick fog, the climbers turned back below the summit.
The firm thanked its staff for attending the party this year.

predictions: median fire ~0.35 (probes: 'concerted' 0.60, 'how hard ... have' 0.50, 'hard work' 0.37); near misses < 0.1 ('hard wooden bench' 0.005); risk: 'strenuous' untested; 'in an' avoided since 'in an hour' also fired 0.17.
notes: Promotes ' effort', ' efforts', ' exert', ' endeavor': a next-token predictor for effort words.
